note: NOTE: Player-facing NPC lines. `desc` is shown in the talk dialog (or kept for later if the role opens a window directly). `notes` is design-only and is never shown in game. v0.1.2-descs.

rows.name: Mara
rows.desc: I buy junk and sell supplies for the pasture.
rows.notes: Meadows vendor. Opens the shop (npc_shop). Design only — this line is unused while role=shop opens the shop directly.

rows.name: Pell
rows.desc: Welcome to Meadow Town! Head east to Sunny Pasture — mice and sheep leave you be unless you hit them, but watch the crows. The dirt path at the far east of the pasture leads on to the Dirt Banks. Press E to pick up drops, sell junk to Mara, and train with Calden.
rows.notes: Town greeter. Grants sq_welcome on first talk. Tutorial-length dialog is longer than item descs on purpose. v0.2.0: mentions the open dirt path to the Dirt Banks.

rows.name: Calden
rows.desc: Bring me Monster Essence and Training Scrolls to rank your skills. Nature, Elemental and Spiritual skills need their own essence and materials.
rows.notes: Skill trainer. Role=trainer opens the skills window directly; desc is kept for later use and documentation.

rows.name: Ila
rows.desc: Ten of a common material for one essence. Nature, Elemental, or Spirit — look at what you're holding.
rows.notes: v0.2.2: 10:1 essence bench is open (exchange tab). role=exchange opens the bench. desc is player-facing; kept even though the window opens directly, for documentation.
